authority: Operator requested C13 workload/budget recommendations and exact control-check instructions. Standing delegation covers inert definitions, local command verification and documentation. This proposal grants no execution, installation, model, service, release or deletion authority.
delivery: One operator on the existing 24 GiB Apple Silicon Mac; foreground Python CLI, local receipt SQLite and private HTML/Markdown. No always-on service or hosted database. Assessment workers remain separate Linux aarch64 containers.

workload.planning_envelope: Up to 50 local candidate/preview/report operations per working day; at most one explicitly reviewed assessment campaign in progress. Capacity target, not observed user demand or model authority.
core_commands: plan essentials with explicit reviewed metadata
workload.assessment: One candidate, capable baseline and treatment in distinct reviewed worker profiles; model execution sequential. Candidate optional in value comparisons; required qualification separate. Excludes arbitrary repo debugging, extra challengers, generated-code training and hosted integrations from this resource proposal.

enforcement: Latency/CPU/whole-host/disk targets are proposed acceptance criteria, not claims of existing enforcement. Existing worker/proxy limits are preserved, not increased. A frozen future driver must implement gates/observations and fail closed on missing measurements.

prospective_qualification.input_freeze: Accept targets first, then materialize and hash fresh sizes/content/order and exact command/output verifiers before any measured run. Existing 24-command calibration inputs never become holdout.
prospective_qualification.p95: Nearest-rank per command class, no pooling preview/candidate with report; show all values. Ten observations per class do not establish population tail latency.
prospective_qualification.resource_only_design: Two cases per each of three bounded editing families, one execution in each arm, sequential seed-balanced order; no holdouts, candidate qualification, admission, efficacy or savings claim.
prospective_qualification.review_required: Fresh exact execution bundle with installed artifact/runtime target, data/driver pins, current conformance, current grant balance/expiry, final model/endpoint, collector coverage and teardown. Earlier five diagnostic reservations are terminal and cannot be reused.

measurement.baseline: Record whole-host CPU/memory/swap/network plus owned process trees and Docker VM/container counters before, during and after. Record Docker warm/cold state separately; no global Docker settings changes.
measurement.host_cpu: Prime nonblocking CPU counters, discard first value; also retain cumulative CPU-time deltas. Whole-host percent converts to cores using observed logical CPU count.
measurement.host_memory: Track aggregate host and owned resident memory separately; no sum of container RSS and Docker VM as physical memory. Baseline differences include other work; record an uninterpretable run if attribution is contaminated.
measurement.docker_memory: Keep raw Docker API usage and cache fields; CLI cache-subtracted memory alone is insufficient for a host-memory claim.
measurement.process: Retain exact argv identities, elapsed monotonic time, CPU time, sampled RSS and OS peak where available. Sampling alone cannot certify a hard peak ceiling; unavailable authoritative peak remains a gap.
measurement.network: Offline commands denied network. Live worker RX+TX is its own dimension; proxy forwarded bytes retained separately, not added again. Whole-host traffic is not attributed as model traffic.
measurement.noise: If baseline host CPU mean exceeds 0.25 logical cores or before/after available-memory medians differ by over 512 MiB, do not claim an attributable whole-system pass. Preserve contaminated run/costs; no automatic repeat.
measurement.energy: Unknown unless a separately reviewed measurement is available; no privileged collector, battery-life, energy-efficiency or carbon claim.
measurement.tokens: Preserve provider_report/self_asserted and raw categories; independent provider metering and trusted savings remain unproven. Subscription use is not cash savings.

stop_rules: Stop new dispatch on a target breach, evidence gap, identity drift or exhausted scope. An in-flight operation may need bounded completion and reconciliation; cancelling scheduling is not proof of termination.
No automatic retries, cap refunds, old-study relabeling or deletion of retained artifacts.
Keep at least 50 GiB free; stop new effects if the reserve or 2 GiB available-memory guard would be crossed. Do not close unrelated applications or alter Docker globally without the operator.
acceptance_scope: A future passing core result covers only the declared local CLI envelope. The 12-turn batch can characterize assessment resources, not replace required 100+ holdouts or qualify a skill. C13/full production and release remain separate decisions.

basis.memory_and_time: 43 MiB sampled CLI maximum and ~0.13–0.14 s medians inform headroom, not proof of the proposed envelope. 256 MiB and 1/2-second p95 are usability targets proposed before fresh qualification.
basis.storage: Existing installer reservation remains authoritative; 512 MiB is a new acceptance target, not permission to force an oversized closure.
basis.version_note: Documentation consulted for metric semantics; installed psutil 6.1.1 and all existing package/image pins remain unchanged.
